proposals.evidence: Turner explicitly derives the metathesized series from laghu and names Nepali halũ/halaũ/huluṅo, Hindi harū/haruā and Gujarati haḷvũ. These whole light adjectives match that l/h or lv series, including nasal and final agreement vowels; initial h loss remains a regional comparison. Forms with k belong to the separate kk extension and are not silently merged here.
